exact_claim_or_summary: Global US dollar allocated foreign exchange reserves declined from ~71% in 2000 to ~58% in 2024–2025.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: IMF Currency Composition of Official Foreign Exchange Reserves (COFER) database (1970–2025)
important_assumptions: Allocated reserves represent reporting central bank portfolios (~90% of global total)
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Erosion has shifted to non-traditional reserve currencies (AUD, CAD, CHF, KRW) and gold rather than a single peer rival like RMB; dollar payment dominance in SWIFT remains >45%

exact_claim_or_summary: US federal net interest outlays reached B in FY2024 (~3.06% of GDP), exceeding national defense spending (B).
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Congressional Budget Office (CBO) Historical Budget Data (October 2024); US Treasury Monthly Treasury Statements
important_assumptions: Gross federal interest adjusted for intragovernmental trust fund holdings yields net outlay
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Spike reflects high short-term policy rates set by the Fed during 2022–2024 inflation cycle; debt servicing costs could moderate if policy rates decline

exact_claim_or_summary: US debt held by the public reached ~99% of GDP in 2024, while gross federal debt reached ~122% of GDP (.4T).
supporting_evidence_and_sources: CBO Budget and Economic Outlook (2024–2034); US Treasury Debt to the Penny
important_assumptions: Distinction between publicly held debt and intragovernmental holdings is preserved; public debt is economically binding metric
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Does not yet exceed the WWII historical peak of 106% of GDP for public debt (set in 1946), though CBO projects crossing it by 2028–2029 under current law

exact_claim_or_summary: Central banks accumulated over 1,000 net metric tons of gold annually across three consecutive years (2022–2024: 1,082t, 1,037t, 1,045t), moderating to 863t in 2025.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: World Gold Council (WGC) Gold Demand Trends (2010–2025)
important_assumptions: Includes estimated unreported purchases by sovereign monetary authorities via Metals Focus data
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Represents sovereign risk management and sanction insulation rather than complete global demonetization of fiat reserves

exact_claim_or_summary: American public confidence in core institutional triad (Congress ~7-9%, Presidency ~30-38%, Supreme Court ~40-43%, Media ~31%) reflects structural secular decay since the 1960s.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Gallup Confidence in Institutions survey series (1973–2024); Edelman Trust Barometer (2000–2024)
important_assumptions: Self-reported public opinion accurately reflects societal institutional cohesion and counterparty legitimacy
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Negative partisanship and fragmented digital media amplify expressed political dissatisfaction without necessarily causing functional operational failure of state bureaucracy
confidence_and_uncertainty: High for polling data; Moderate for causal extrapolation to institutional collapse

exact_claim_or_summary: Frontier AI model training compute has scaled at ~4.0 to ~4.6 month doubling times since 2010, growing from 10^18 FLOP to >10^26 FLOP by 2024–2025.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Epoch AI Parameter, Compute and Data Trends in Machine Learning (Sevilla et al., 2022, updated 2024–2025)
important_assumptions: FLOP counts derived from published parameter architectures and training hardware disclosures
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Pre-training scaling curves encounter data wall constraints and gigawatt power interconnect bottlenecks, causing frontier labs to redirect compute to test-time search and inference scaling

exact_claim_or_summary: Autonomous task-completion time horizons measured by METR doubled from ~15 minutes (GPT-4, 2023) to ~4h49m (Opus 4.5, Nov 2025), ~12h (Opus 4.6, Feb 2026), and ~17h (Mythos Preview, Apr 2026).
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Model Evaluation and Threat Research (METR) Task-Completion Horizon Benchmarks (2024–2026)
important_assumptions: 50% completion probability on human-calibrated multi-step software and system administration tasks; measurements >16h carry wide statistical error margins
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Evaluation suite saturation, benchmark leakage, and steep reliability drop-offs on out-of-distribution planning tasks
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate-to-High (empirical METR data, with statistical caveat on >16h horizons)

exact_claim_or_summary: Tokenized real-world assets (RWA)—specifically tokenized US Treasuries and cash equivalents—expanded from M in 2022 to over B by 2026.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: rwa.xyz analytics; BlackRock BUIDL, Franklin Templeton BENJI fund data (2023–2026)
important_assumptions: Excludes uncollateralized crypto assets and fiat-pegged centralized stablecoins (USDT/USDC), isolating yield-bearing institutional instruments
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Remains a small fraction (<0.05%) of the T+ total marketable US Treasury market; primarily used as crypto trading collateral rather than mainstream payment settlement
confidence_and_uncertainty: High (on-chain verified contracts and prospectus disclosures)

exact_claim_or_summary: Metaculus aggregate community median prediction for the arrival of Artificial General Intelligence compressed from 2050 (in 2020) to ~2027 (in 2023), before drifting outward to 2031–2033 by 2026.
important_assumptions: Metaculus operational criteria for AGI (Turing test, general visual/text reasoning, robotics, software generation)
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Forecasting crowd reflects public hype cycles and recent capability breakthroughs rather than physical or theoretical necessity; timeline volatility indicates epistemic uncertainty

exact_claim_or_summary: Strauss and Howe (1997) predicted an American Fourth Turning crisis beginning in the mid-2000s and culminating around the late 2020s, driven by an 80–100 year saecular generational cycle.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Strauss & Howe, The Fourth Turning (Broadway Books, 1997)
important_assumptions: Four recurring generational archetypes (Prophet, Nomad, Hero, Artist) cyclically rotate over biological life phases with constant period lengths
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Criticized by professional historians for historical cherry-picking, confirmation bias, flexible phase boundaries, and unfalsifiable catalyst definitions
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate for qualitative resonance; Low for deterministic mathematical periodicity

exact_claim_or_summary: Kondratiev wave theory posits 50–60 year macroeconomic cycles driven by basic capital infrastructure investments and technological paradigm shifts.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Nikolai Kondratiev (1925); Joseph Schumpeter, Business Cycles (1939); Carlota Perez (2002)
important_assumptions: Clustering of radical innovations triggers systematic long-run waves in interest rates, commodity prices, and capital formation
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Kuznets (1940) and modern econometricians (e.g. Solomou, 1987) demonstrate spectral analysis of GDP data fails to isolate statistically significant fixed 50–60 year periodicities once trends and wars are removed
confidence_and_uncertainty: Low-to-Moderate (heuristic framework rather than verified empirical law)

exact_claim_or_summary: The differential equation dI/dt = alpha * I^gamma causes a finite-time mathematical singularity for any gamma >= 1.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: IJ Good (1965); Vernor Vinge (1993); standard ordinary differential equations theory
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: gamma = 1 yields pure exponential growth I(t) = I_0 * e^(alpha*t), which remains finite for all finite t; finite-time blow-up requires strictly gamma > 1

exact_claim_or_summary: A literal technological singularity will occur between 2026 and 2035 via recursive self-improvement of artificial cognitive architectures.
important_assumptions: Intelligence can be recursively abstracted without thermodynamic, physical fabrication, or algorithmic friction bounds
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Landauer thermodynamic limits, Von Neumann memory bottlenecks, diminishing returns to cognitive scaling (Jones, 2020), and economic diffusion lags

exact_claim_or_summary: Ray Dalio’s Big Cycle framework identifies a deterministic 250-year empire cycle containing three ~50–75 year long-term debt cycles.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Ray Dalio, Principles for Dealing with the Changing World Order (2021)
important_assumptions: Historical empires (Dutch, British, American) follow uniform six-stage lifecycles of rise, peak, and internal/external conflict
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Historical sample size is tiny (n=3 modern reserve currency transitions); institutional variations, nuclear deterrence, and globalized supply chains prevent identical cyclic repetition
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate for descriptive archetypes; Low for deterministic periodicity

exact_claim_or_summary: Verifiable cryptographic systems (smart contracts, oracle networks, zero-knowledge proofs) will systematically absorb institutional counterparty settlement functions.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: DTCC, Swift, Euroclear tokenization pilot studies; Chainlink CCIP and PoR architecture
important_assumptions: Cryptographic consensus eliminates legal and institutional counterparty risks without introducing unmanageable technical or smart contract vulnerabilities
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Legal enforcement, sovereign court jurisdiction, and political sovereign coercion remain primary final settlement arbiters; institutional adoption may remain hybrid permissioned ledgers rather than public open networks
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate (proven production pilots, but legal primacy unresolved)

exact_claim_or_summary: Five independent macro cycles (Dalio, Strauss-Howe, Kondratiev, Kurzweil, Perez) synchronously converge in a singular 2026–2035 transition window.
supporting_evidence_and_sources: Synthesized comparative chronologies across all five pillar dossiers
important_assumptions: The five frameworks are independent lines of confirmation rather than correlated cultural artifacts with malleable time boundaries
counterevidence_or_competing_explanation: Frameworks share common underlying observational data (US post-war economic history); dates have been retrospectively fitted to match current crises; narrative convergence rather than physical causal synchrony
confidence_and_uncertainty: Low-to-Moderate (provocative synthesis, but lacks proof of independent causal synchronization)
